title: Grounded answer generation on frozen benchmark v4 evidence
hypothesis: Changing only the generator model produces measurable differences in grounded answer quality, citation behavior, latency, and cost when retrieval evidence and prompting are frozen.

selectionRule.testExecution: exactly once after human review and judge calibration are frozen

executionRules.providerAndModelMismatch: fail the case and record the error
executionRules.cache: content-addressed; retries reuse identical successful responses
executionRules.judge: disabled until human reference labels are complete
executionRules.qualityDecision: never infer a winner from cost or latency alone

amendments.change: Pin GLM-5.2 FP8 to BaseTen instead of Z.AI; model, quantization, reasoning controls, and list prices remain unchanged.
amendments.reason: The Z.AI endpoint changed to OpenRouter status -2 with approximately 92% five-minute uptime and did not return the first benchmark response. BaseTen FP8 reported status 0 and 100% thirty-minute uptime.
amendments.selectionRule: Highest observed thirty-minute uptime among healthy FP8 endpoints at the same frozen list price; no answer-quality output was available when selected.

amendments.change: Use low rather than medium reasoning effort for every candidate; prompt, 900-token ceiling, and all other controls remain unchanged.
amendments.reason: A non-benchmark operational probe showed that GLM-5.2 at medium effort exhausted a small output allowance entirely on reasoning. At low effort it produced the requested content while still exposing reasoning-token usage. The Google baseline is regenerated under the amended setting.
amendments.selectionRule: Apply the same explicit nominal effort to all candidates before producing comparison outputs; do not inspect answer quality during the operational probe.

transientEvents: The original Z.AI GLM endpoint became degraded before returning a benchmark answer; the preregistered amendment switched to BaseTen FP8 before answer quality was observed.
BaseTen returned one upstream 429 on the first complete attempt. A cache-preserving rerun retried only that case and completed 27/27 GLM answers without fallback.
execution.selectionStatus: GLM-5.2 BaseTen FP8 selected on human-reviewed validation quality; untouched-test confirmation remains pending.

humanReview.limitation: The initial human reference has one reviewer; judge disagreements and a random agreement sample should receive a second audit.
